chat.author: Natrajan Venkataraman
chat.text:
In using Large Comm for finding the source of the End Point being advertised, Two main points. 
EBGP add-path does not scale well with large DCs. If add-path does not scale, how are you addressing/overcoming path hiding. In the BGP CT/CAR discussions these were extensively discussed. To solve the above problems, advertsiing the Endpoint with EGP CT for IP Fabric Networks seems to fit this problem space better. It solves the Add-Path scaling issue as well as the Path hiding
